literal: The ruler protects the world all; him justice protects, without failing if he administers.
translation: The ruler protects the entire world; and if he administers justice without failing, that justice itself will protect him.
modern: அரசன் உலகத்தில் உள்ள எல்லாரையும் காப்பாற்றுவான்; அவன் தன் செங்கோல் ஆட்சியைத் தடையின்றிச் செய்வானானால், அந்த நீதியே அவனைக் காப்பாற்றும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the reciprocal relationship between a ruler and the justice they administer. While the ruler's duty is to protect all the people of the world, the ruler's own safety is secured by their adherence to justice. If the ruler administers justice ('முறை') without any failure or lapse ('முட்டாச் செயின்'), that very justice will serve as a shield to protect them. Thus, the ultimate protector of a sovereign is not their military might, but their own righteous governance.
